name: Azure agent-assist for synthetic support calls

data.label: Synthetic caller
data.description: Test caller placing synthetic inbound calls. Outside provisioning scope.

data.label: Call intake & audio stream
data.description: Answers inbound calls only and plays the consent prompt. Streams audio only after consent is recorded. Outbound calling is not enabled.
data.service: Azure Communication Services (Call Automation, media streaming)

data.label: Consent gate
data.description: Records the caller's consent decision with a timestamp and call ID in Cosmos DB. Blocks transcription when consent is refused or missing (fail closed).

data.label: Real-time transcription
data.description: Turns consented audio into a live transcript, labelled by speaker.
data.service: Azure AI Speech (real-time speech to text)

data.label: PII redaction
data.description: Redacts personal data from transcript segments before any prompt, storage or display beyond the live call.

data.label: Agent-assist orchestrator
data.description: Retrieves knowledge for redacted transcript turns and asks the model for cited suggestions. Drafts the call summary and the CRM update. It has read-only tools and no CRM write or calling permission.

data.label: Knowledge index
data.description: Index of approved support articles used to ground suggestions. Source content is treated as untrusted data.

data.label: Language model
data.description: Model deployment for suggestions and summaries. It only receives redacted text. The model, region and quota are still to be chosen and checked.

data.label: Agent desktop
data.description: Shows live suggestions with sources. The agent edits and approves the summary and CRM draft. Nothing is sent onward without approval.

data.label: Agent sign-in
data.description: Signs agents in to the desktop app and assigns roles. The tenant is not yet confirmed.

data.label: Support agent
data.description: Person who handles the call, approves the summary and manually saves the CRM draft.

data.label: Existing CRM
data.description: The current CRM, product not yet named. The system has no write access. Only the agent saves the update.

data.label: Call records
data.description: Stores the consent record, redacted transcript, approved summary, CRM draft and approval audit trail. Retention is not yet decided.

data.label: Monitoring & audit
data.description: Collects traces, latency, errors and redaction failures. Logs exclude raw PII.

brief.application: Use Azure for this synthetic architecture qualification. Assist an agent during a synthetic support call. Include consent, audio ingestion, transcription, PII redaction, grounded agent suggestions, an approved call summary and a draft update to an existing CRM. Do not place calls or write CRM records automatically. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

decisions.subject: design.azure-agent-assist-for-synthetic-support-calls-first-concrete-sketch
decisions.title: Azure agent-assist for synthetic support calls (first concrete sketch)
decisions.context: Scope: inbound synthetic call → consent gate → real-time transcription → PII redaction → grounded suggestions to a human agent → agent-approved summary and CRM draft. The system never makes outbound calls or writes to the CRM. The agent copies the approved draft into the existing CRM themselves. Assumptions: region not chosen; service availability, model access and quotas not checked; Terraform generator coverage for these Azure services is not native, so engineering is required. Local tests use mocked speech, PII and model behaviour only.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.

needs.statement: Proposed: no audio may be transcribed or stored until the caller's consent is recorded. Missing or refused consent stops processing.
needs.rationale: Recording without consent creates legal risk. A fail-closed gate makes this testable.

needs.statement: Proposed: transcript text is redacted for PII before it reaches the model, storage or logs.
needs.rationale: Stops personal data from leaking into prompts, records and logs.

needs.statement: Proposed: the system never places calls or writes CRM records. The summary and CRM draft need the agent's approval, and only the agent saves to the CRM.
needs.rationale: Prevents unreviewed AI output from changing customer records.
needs.basis: User: "Do not place calls or write CRM records automatically."
